name: Mochizuki (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Mochizuki town emblem in white: a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Mochizuki in Nagano Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-04-01.

features.role: Mochizuki town emblem — a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars enclosing a stylised character
